parameters.name: IpsecServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPsec server.

parameters.name: IpsecServerName
parameters.description:
The name of the IPsec server.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **20**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:

- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent query exists.

- If a subsequent query exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the IPsec server.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID of the IPsec server.

The IPsec server belongs to the same resource group as the associated VPN gateway instance. You can call the [DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~) operation to query the resource group ID of the VPN gateway instance.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.
